names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 30 octombrie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Zenovie, Episcopul Ciliciei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 30 октября ст. ст., «Святитель Зиновий Егейский (Киликийский), епископ, сщмч.», with the rank words and the grade left off. The link gives the see twice over, as of Aegae and in brackets as Cilician; the day's line gives «еп. Егейского» alone.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 30. октобар ст. ст., „Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија.“ — «Свешт. муч.» is the `hieromartyr` grade this corpus keeps in `types` and comes off, and «и сестра му Зиновија» is the second person the heading enumerates and no part of his name. The heading gives him no see: «епископа Егејског» is the body’s, and the folder carries it in `office`. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian calendars keep the pair on their own 30 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day for the same pair and not a second day on one calendar. His life page is headed «День памяти: 30 октября» and lists no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Зиновия , еп. Егейского, и сестры его Зиновии (285).»
source.note: The line is the first of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the Greek and Romanian days this folder was written from, prints the pair's two hymns, and adds the whole of a life neither of them had: the parents from whom the two took the faith, the inheritance given away, the gift of healing, the election to the see, Diocletian's persecution, the governor Lysias and his two sentences, the saint's answer, the cross, the red-hot bed, the boiling cauldron, the beheading and the presbyter who buried them. It states the year flatly, «претерпели мученическую смерть в 285 году», where saint.gr prints 285 and offers Diocletian as an alternative account; the Russian life has both at once, dating the reign «(284-305)» and the martyrdom 285, so the folder's existing interval stands unchanged and is now carried by two calendars. Lysias is the same governor of Cilicia before whom the previous day's company of four stood in the same year.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 30 octombrie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Zenovie, Episcopul Ciliciei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: of Aegae in Cilicia, a physician who took no fee, arrested by the governor Lysias, beheaded with his sister. A `dates` object is proposed from this page where the folder had none. The page's own σημείωση supports the folder's office: «όταν μεγάλωσε έγινε επίσκοπος Αιγών, επιτελώντας πολλά θαύματα», and names his parents Zenodotos and Thekla. It records a fragment of his relics at the monastery of Kato Xenia at Almyros in Magnesia. The apolytikion and the kontakion both name him and his sister and are taken into both folders; the Οἶκος is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.11.2025 (30. октобар ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, which ENUMERATES TWO PEOPLE in one heading — «Свешт. муч. Зиновије и сестра му Зиновија» — so it is two folders and two rows, this one and `zenobia-sister-of-zenobius`. Both already existed and already related one another in both directions, so no `related` row is owed either way, and both rows quote the whole heading (BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4). `types` UNTOUCHED: «Свешт. муч.» is the `hieromartyr` this folder holds, the body’s «би Зиновије постављен за епископа Егејског» the `bishop`, and its «даром чудотворства» the `wonderworker` — all three were already there, and the `office` «Bishop of Aegae in Cilicia» matches the body’s «епископа Егејског» and the entry’s own «Из града Егеја у Киликији». `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE BOOK HEDGES WHERE THE FOLDER DOES NOT. The folder holds `death` 285 flat, off saint.gr’s heading «Αγιος Ζηνοβιος (; - 285)». This entry says «бише обоје мачем посечени око 285. год.» — both beheaded ABOUT 285. Same number, with an «око» in front of it, which is a weaker statement than the folder already carries and so changes nothing; a second book agreeing less precisely is not a reason to loosen an interval. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. BROTHER AND SISTER INHERITED BOTH THE TRUE FAITH AND A GREAT MATERIAL FORTUNE FROM THEIR PARENTS, AND GAVE THE FORTUNE AWAY TO THE POOR; and this book draws the causal line itself — because their hands were merciful, THE HAND OF GOD COVERED THEM from every evil design of men and of demons, and ZENOBIUS’S MERCIFUL HANDS, THE ONES THAT GAVE TO THE POOR, WERE THE HANDS GOD GAVE THE GIFT OF WONDERWORKING TO, so that he healed every sickness BY THE TOUCH OF HIS HANDS ALONE. The judge is named: ЛИСИЈЕ, Lysias, who put it to him „Предлажем ти двоје – живот и смрт; живот ако се поклониш боговима, смрт ако се не поклониш“ — I offer thee two things, life and death; life if thou wilt bow to the gods, death if thou wilt not. And Zenobius answered „Живот без Христа није живот но смрт, а смрт Христа ради није смрт но живот“ — life without Christ is not life but death, and death for Christ’s sake is not death but life. THE TORMENTS ARE NAMED: fire, and boiling pitch, and then the sword. NO NEW `related`, no `locations` — Aegae and Cilicia are named and are already in the `office` rather than in a coordinate. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Зиновије» and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts 0 other holders, which is worth saying because the corpus does keep a `zenobius-mazhuga` and this folder relates him. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about king Milutin.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Zenovie, Episcopul Ciliciei, și al Sfintei Mucenițe Zenovia, sora sa, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received incorruptible crowns from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength they overthrew their torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Ὡς θεῖοι αὐτάδελφοι ὁμονοοῦντες καλῶς, Ζηνόβιε ἔνδοξε καὶ Ζηνοβία σεμνή, συμφώνως ἠθλήσατε· ὅθεν καὶ τῶν στεφανῶν τῶν ἀφθάρτων τυχόντες, δόξης ἀκαταλύτου ἠξιώθητε, ἅμα ἐκλάμποντες τοῖς ἐν κόσμῳ χάριν ἰάσεων.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια». It names the two of them and no other saint.

english.text: As godly brother and sister well agreed together, glorious Zenobius and modest Zenobia, you contended with one voice; and so, having obtained the incorruptible crowns, you were counted worthy of indissoluble glory, shining out together upon those in the world with the grace of healings.

hymns.text: Τοὺς ἀληθείας Μάρτυρας, καὶ εὐσεβείας κήρυκας, τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὴν δυάδα τιμήσωμεν, ἐν θεοπνεύστοις ᾄσμασι, τὸν Zηvόβιοv ἅμα τῇ σεπτῇ Zηνοβία, ὁμοῦ βιώσαντας, καὶ διὰ μαρτυρίου τευξαμένους στέφος ἄφθαρτον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς — on the page of «Άγιοι Ζηνόβιος και Ζηνοβία τα αδέλφια». It names the two of them and no other saint. The readings «Zηvόβιοv» and «Zηνοβία» with Latin letters among the Greek are the page's own and are copied as they stand.

english.text: Let us honour in God-inspired songs the martyrs of the truth and heralds of godliness, the pair of brother and sister, Zenobius together with the revered Zenobia, who lived together and by martyrdom obtained the incorruptible crown.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости,/ тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь священномученика Зиновия и мученицы Зиновии». The text is the common of martyrs and names neither of them; it is printed under their names on the day page and is copied whole, as the brief directs.

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, received from You, our God, crowns that do not fade, for in their sufferings they had Your strength; they threw down their torturers and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers, save our souls.

hymns.text: Истины свидетели и благочестия проповедники,/ двоицу достойно почтим в богодухновенных песнех,/ Зиновия вкупе с мудрою Зиновиею,/ купно жившия и отшедшия// и мучением приимшия венец нетленный.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак священномученика Зиновия и мученицы Зиновии»

english.text: Witnesses of the truth and preachers of godliness, let us honour the two of them worthily in God-inspired songs: Zenobius together with the wise Zenobia, who lived together and departed together, and by their martyrdom received the crown that does not fade.

death.note: saint.gr's heading for him, «Αγιος Ζηνοβιος (; - 285)», and in the notice «Και οι δύο θανατώθηκαν με αποκεφαλισμό κατόπιν βασανιστηρίων το 285 μ.Χ.». The same page adds a σημείωση that by another account he suffered under Diocletian, whose reign begins in 284; the year is recorded because the page states it, and the alternative is recorded here because the page prints it.
